_about: One everyday detail of how a drafted character looks, rolled by dramatis/looks.py so the Appearance never falls back on the model's own favourite (three drafts in a row came back with a chickenpox scar above the left eyebrow). Habits, wear and what they carry, not marks on their body: a mark people notice is the Something people notice field. 'any' fits every era; 'modern' only the present day and the future.
any: sleeves always pushed up to the elbow
a pencil tucked behind one ear
keys clipped to a belt loop
a ring they turn when they are thinking
shoes resoled more than once
a coat a size too big
a collar that never sits flat
hair that escapes whatever holds it by noon
callused fingertips
short, practical nails
a habit of standing with their weight on one hip
reading glasses on a cord
a scarf in every season
a faded patch where a bag strap rubs
a button sewn back on in the wrong colour
a handkerchief always in one pocket
flour or dust on their cuffs more often than not
a slight squint when they read
a posture that straightens when someone looks at them
a watch worn face-in on the wrist
boots with the laces wrapped twice
chapped lips in winter
a pocket that always holds something to eat
clothes chosen for pockets
modern: phone in a cracked case with a card wedged behind it
earbuds that live around their neck
a lanyard they forget to take off
a hair tie always on one wrist
a tote bag from a shop that closed years ago
a fitness watch they never charge
sunglasses pushed up on their head indoors
a backpack with one strap broken
a reusable cup with a chipped lid
trainers worn down at the heels
a jacket with a pin from a band nobody else knows
